result.evidence_quote: We investigated population-wide changes in prescriptions of oral anticoagulants (OAC) (vitamin K antagonists [VKA]) compared to direct oral anticoagulants (DOAC) and whether these translated into a decline in incidences of OAC-related intracerebral hemorrhages (ICH).
result.rationale: The study examines anticoagulant prescribing and associated intracerebral hemorrhage incidence. It does not address cancer biology, tumor progression, tumor biomarkers, or cancer treatments.
